## Type

- [ ] fix: bug fix

- [ ] docs: documentation

## Testing

- [ ] `pnpm run build` passes

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `feat/*`, `fix/*`, `refactor/*`, `docs/*` convention
- [ ] Commits follow `type(scope): description` format
- [ ] No unrelated changes included
